recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as-is. Do not revert medication-codes to 410942007 for FHIR-7743; any future Medication.code terminology change should be handled as a new Pharmacy/terminology decision that considers the later 763158003 medicinal-product binding.
issue_request: FHIR-7743 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU1 May 2015 ballot. It reported that the example SNOMED CT value set linked from Medication/valueset-medication-codes contained route-of-administration codes rather than medication codes, asked for clearer text on possible sources, and recorded an approved correction to use SNOMED CT medication concepts stated as concept is-a 410942007.
initial_application: No direct source commit was found that names FHIR-7743 or old core issue #1034. The same Medication.code route-code defect was applied through the adjacent ballot issue family: commit 6ce87fde09500c2d61c86a07ac98f49037e7d747, titled '#8064 - fixed Medication.code exemplar valueset', changed source/medication/valueset-medication-codes.xml from SNOMED CT route-of-administration root 284009009 to medication root 410942007. Related final Jira issues FHIR-8022 and FHIR-8064 record the same Medication.code correction, and FHIR-8064 explicitly duplicates FHIR-8022.
additional_context: Medication is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml binds Medication.code to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-codes, and current source/medication/valueset-medication-codes.xml describes and composes SNOMED CT medicinal product concepts under 763158003. That differs from the 2015 410942007 wording because later Published/Persuasive Pharmacy work superseded the exact root: FHIR-8435 expanded the exemplar medication value set to multiple medication/product roots, and FHIR-19294 later changed the Medication SNOMED binding to medicinal product root 763158003. The combined branch already contains reconciliation audits for FHIR-8022, FHIR-8061, FHIR-8064, and FHIR-19294. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-7743 and medication-code/SNOMED value-set terms found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: This empty audit commit intentionally makes no source change. The old route-of-administration value set link/content is gone from the authoritative current Medication source, and reapplying the 2015 410942007 text would undo later final terminology decisions rather than improve the current build.
